name: Uranian-Tombolo
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond magnetic pole anomalies, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Whoever abandoned the buried megastructure did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
There is money in platinum here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
